FAQ

Common questions

Will these fit my BMW?

The housing fits the factory door-puddle-light socket used across compatible 2, 3, 4, 5 and 8 Series doors with the OEM 2-pin harness. Use the fitment checker above for an instant answer, or message us your chassis code before ordering if you're still unsure.

Do I need to cut any wires?

No. The kit uses the same 2-pin connector as your factory puddle light, so it clips directly into the existing harness.

What's the shipping cost?

Shipping is free for all orders within North America. International shipping is calculated automatically at checkout based on destination.

What if a unit arrives faulty?

Every kit ships with a 12-month warranty. Contact us with your order number and we'll send a replacement.

Where do I pick up my order in Vancouver?

We don't have a storefront — after you check out with local pickup, we'll email you to arrange a time and a public meeting spot in Vancouver (usually a well-lit parking garage or public lot) that's convenient for both of us.
